visualCharacteristics.purpose: Dropdown select (e.g. "All Cards") that filters the card groups or comparison tables that follow it on the page

contentPattern.structure: one row per dropdown option: cell 1 = option label (the first row is the "show all" option, e.g. All Cards), optional cell 2 = filter value. Filtered groups are the blocks after the filter in the same section, matched by their caption or heading text, or sections with a Filter section-metadata value

reuseGuidance: Use above a run of grouped content (tables or card lists) that each carry a category heading/caption matching an option label.
